label: Bible Study
prompt: Husbands, love your _____, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verse: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
note: Paul's standard for husbands — love measured by Christ's self-giving.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou drewest _____ in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
verse: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
note: The poet called from the low dungeon, and God drew near and said two words: Fear not.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee _____ for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
verse: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.
note: For Jonathan's sake, David gave lame Mephibosheth his land back and a permanent seat at the king's table.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to _____ life.
verse: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
note: Joseph, revealing himself to the brothers who sold him, reframes the whole betrayal as God's rescue plan.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an _____ of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
verse: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
note: The Philippians' gift, carried by Epaphroditus, was 'an odour of a sweet smell' — the KJV spells it British.
